React directives:
- `'use client'` marks Client Components for hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`), event handlers (`onClick`, `onChange`), and browser APIs (`window`, `localStorage`). https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client
- `'use server'` marks Server Actions, including functions passed to Client Components or defined inline in Server Components. https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-server
- `'use cache'` enables caching in Next.js Cache Components. Requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. For `cacheLife()`, `cacheTag()`, and `updateTag()`, see the `next-cache-components` skill. https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
